fully_diluted.description: Every share fully diluted: the shares issued, the options granted and what the option pool leaves to grant.

holders.description: Every holder with shares or options, by name.

lines.description: Every holding with shares or options, by holder's name, then class.

options.description: The options the recorded grants made by the day granted, each counted in its holder's line (FR-EQ-19).

pool_diluted.description: The unallocated pool's percentage of every share fully diluted; left out when the pool leaves nothing.

unallocated_pool.description: What the option pool in force leaves to grant (FR-EQ-19): its size less the options granted, counted in fully_diluted.
